data.name: Sora
data.long_meaning: In Japanese, Sora means 'sky' or 'heaven'. It is derived from the Proto-Japanese word *su-ra, which means 'to soar, fly, or float'. In Christian contexts, Sora can symbolize the spiritual realm, the heavens, or the divine.
